name: Farmroll
description_long: Gamified crypto engagement platform on Cardano. Projects launch interactive campaigns and quests; users complete tasks to earn rewards without any upfront investment, with XP tracking and user profiles. Also offers an AI agent launchpad for automating social interactions, content creation, and on-chain activity. The native $ROLL token is used for rewards, staking, campaign funding, and governance. Originally built as a tool for a crypto casino before expanding into a general engagement hub.
